rows.sentence: Dawa nyingi za binadamu ziko katika daraja la zero-rated (tozo 0%).

Hospitali ya binafsi inayouza dawa (zero-rated) NA inatoa huduma za matibabu (msamaha) inapaswa kufanya hivi: (1) Kwa dawa (zero-rated): inatozwa VAT 0% = inaweza kudai input VAT; (2) Kwa huduma za matibabu (exempt): haikatwi VAT kabisa = haiwezi kudai input VAT.
Lakini kama kliniki hiyo pia inauza vifaa tiba (zero-rated) na bidhaa nyingine zinazotozwa VAT, basi inatakiwa kusajiliwa VAT.
Bidhaa fulani za muhimu (kama nafaka, dawa, baadhi ya vifaa vya kilimo) zinaweza kuwa zero-rated (asilimia 0) au exempt, lakini asilimia 5 haipo.
Some essential items (like certain grains, medicines, some agricultural inputs) may be zero-rated (0%) or exempt, but 5% does not exist.
Certain pharmaceutical products may be VAT-exempt or zero-rated — the EFD must have software that can correctly categorise them.
Hali ya VAT kwa dawa za binadamu — kama zimesamehewa, zero-rated, au zinaapply msamaha maalum — ni mada inayohusisha Jedwali la VAT Act la Tanzania ambapo baadhi ya dawa zimeorodheshwa tofauti.
